Force of Law is a Premium Warbond available for 1,000 Super Credits in the Warbonds tab of the Acquisition Center.

Overview

Players can use Medals to claim various items, including 1 booster, 2 stratagems, 2 weapons, 2 armors, 12 cosmetics, and 300 Super Credits. These rewards are spread across three pages, each requiring increasingly more Medals (ranging from 2 to 110). Players start on page one, unlocking subsequent pages as they spend more Medals, gradually expanding their customization options.
